arguments.value: Jonathan Allen Kobes, born in Sioux City, Iowa, in 1974, is a judge on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit, to which he was nominated by President Donald J. Trump in 2018 and confirmed by the Senate later that year. He earned a B.A. from Dordt College in 1996 and a J.D. from Harvard Law School in 2000. Kobes began his legal career as a law clerk to Judge Roger L. Wollman on the Eighth Circuit, then served as an honors attorney at the Central Intelligence Agency and as an assistant U.S. attorney in the District of South Dakota. He later practiced law in Sioux Falls and held counsel and senior counsel roles at POET, LLC, senior regulatory counsel positions at DuPont Pioneer, and director of corporate compliance at Raven Industries before serving in the office of U.S. Sen. M. Michael Rounds in a variety of legal and leadership roles.
